description: Vertiv Exporter overview for exporter health, ENV_THD sensors, UPS devices, and AC precision cooling devices.

panels.description: 1 means every configured device on the selected Vertiv target was collected successfully.
panels.title: Exporter / Target Health
ENV_THD · 环境阈值与传感器

panels.description: Vertiv SmartRow 2 RDU-THD factory defaults: cold aisle 18–27°C and hot aisle 18–40°C. A single out-of-range sensor is a warning; rack high-temperature alarms are shown separately.
panels.title: THD Temperature

panels.description: Vertiv SmartRow 2 RDU-THD factory default humidity range is 8–95%. A single out-of-range sensor is a warning, not a critical rack alarm.
panels.title: THD Humidity

panels.description: Vertiv SmartRow 2 classifies an open door as Maintenance rather than Alarm, so the open state is yellow instead of red.
panels.title: THD Door Status

panels.description: Inventory table. Each metric keeps the unit documented by the exporter; lifetime energy is shown separately in MWh to avoid mixing kWh with percent, minutes, seconds, and days.
panels.title: UPS Battery & Runtime Inventory

panels.description: Lifetime counters exported in kWh and divided by 1000 for display as MWh. These counters have no health threshold; use power, load, battery, and alarm panels for current health.
panels.title: UPS Lifetime Energy (MWh)

panels.description: Includes discharge temperature. Vertiv public CRV/CRD documentation does not publish one universal high-discharge-temperature setpoint; keep the trend informational and use the controller alarm state for health.
panels.title: AC Temperature Metrics

panels.description: Includes discharge pressure. Vertiv CRV+ documents a 37 bar R410A high-pressure switch point and no discharge-pressure lower fault limit; values below 20 bar must not be colored as faults.
panels.title: AC Pressure Metrics

panels.description: Raw device signal values. Unit is device-dependent and signal_name is a dynamic label.
panels.title: AC Raw Signals

title: Vertiv Exporter Overview
